text:
Maria: Hey design — need a set of mini case-study cards for the go-live on Wed. 6 variants: product highlight, latency/cost stat, customer quote, screenshot + CTA, feature comparison, and a benchmark sparkline. Mobile-first, low touch. Can we get initial comps by EOD Mon?
Sam: Got it. Any brand / copy constraints I should follow? sizes?
Maria: Main constraints: brand color palette A only, use 'Redwood Sans' 700 for headings, short copy (<= 90 chars). For social: 1080x1080, 1080x1350, 1200x628. Use accessible contrast.
Oliver: Also: don't use gradients on stat cards, use approved icon set (see link). Export: PNG + SVG and @2x PNG. Include a text-only variant for alt text.
Elaine: For paid social, we need 3 variants: static image, 15s animated GIF (logo reveal) and story crop. Also include alt copy and primary CTA 'Try Redwood' + UTM params.
Travis: Content note — benchmark numbers to call out: 2.5x throughput vs baseline, ~30% lower per-token cost, median p95 latency 120ms. Prioritize throughput and cost cards for hero slots.
Sam: Thanks — can you drop the exact copy for each card here? I'll drop rough comps after lunch.
Maria: Copy drafts:
- Throughput: "Up to 2.5x throughput on common LLMs"
- Cost: "Save ~30% per token with smart batching"
- Latency: "P95 latency ~120ms in typical configs"
- Quote: "Switching to Redwood cut inference cost and improved response times" — Jane, Acme
- Screenshot: "Product UI + caption: 'One API. Predictable latency.'"
- Compare: "Small model, big gains — quantization + caching"
Sam: Perfect. I'll post first round by 2pm. @DesignBot can you pull the official icon pack?
DesignBot: Pulled icons: https://assets.redwood/icons-v3.zip
Oliver: Also add a brand QA checklist — high contrast, legal footer, logo safe zone. I'll ping legal for disclaimer text.
Maria: Thanks team. Deadline EOD Tue for final exports. @Elaine I'll need the 15s GIF storyboard by tomorrow noon.
Elaine: On it. Will prototype frames and share.
Sam: Putting a quick file tree in case it's helpful:
```
/go-live/casecards/
  comps/ (figma links)
  exports/ (PNG, SVG)
  specs.txt
```
Maria: Awesome. Tag me on the Figma files. :thumbsup:
